name: Baked Sweet Potato Chaat
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: ½ tsp each cumin and chilli powder
½ tsp chaat masala and ¼ tsp black salt
steps: Toss the sweet potato with the oil, cumin and chilli powder.
Roast at 220°C for 20–25 minutes, turning once, until tender and lightly charred.
Toss the sweet potato and chickpeas with the onion, tomato and lemon juice.
Season with chaat masala and black salt, then top with coriander and pomegranate.
note: A fasting-friendly snack that is naturally sweet with no added sugar.
